value.name: Lucia approaches with folded page
value.description: Lucia comes down to meet Asha and stops above her, holding a folded handwritten page between them.
evidence: Lucia came down to meet her without speaking, stopping a step above Asha so that the paper was between them at chest height
it had been written, not typed

value.name: Asha recognizes shaky handwriting
value.description: Asha notices the page is handwritten and that the handwriting matches the shaky hand from the codicil downstairs.
evidence: did her hand loosen enough to show that the page had been written, not typed, and that the hand was the same shaky hand from the codicil downstairs

value.name: Daniel speaks from below
value.description: Daniel's voice starts and stops in the hall below while Lucia and Asha ignore it.
evidence: Below them in the hall, Daniel's voice started and stopped; neither of them looked down for it

value.name: Lucia silently offers the page
value.description: Lucia extends the page toward Asha and waits for her response without speaking.
evidence: Lucia held the page out the last few inches between them
her eyes lifting from the crease to Asha's face and staying there, waiting for something Asha was not sure she could give yet

value.name: Asha takes the page carefully
value.description: Asha accepts the page without pulling and keeps the fold covered to avoid exposing the handwriting.
evidence: Asha took it from her without pulling, two fingers along the fold so the shaky hand on the inside did not have to be uncovered on the stairs

value.name: Asha senses Lucia's sacrifice
value.description: Asha sees that Lucia has spent the morning behind a half-shut door to produce whatever the page contains.
evidence: met Lucia's look long enough to see that whatever this was had cost her the morning behind a half-shut door

value.name: Asha asks who witnessed document
value.description: Asha quietly asks who witnessed the document, trying to keep the question from being heard below.
evidence: "Who witnessed this," Asha said, dropped almost to nothing, close enough that Daniel's voice starting up again in the hall below did not reach them

value.name: Lucia withholds witness name
value.description: Lucia does not answer immediately, signaling that she is about to reveal the witness but not yet aloud.
evidence: Lucia's finger, the one that had been pinning the crease, curled back against her cardigan; she did not answer at once, but she did not look away either
Asha understood that the name was coming, only not yet at the volume the hall could hear

value.name: Asha guesses Rosa witnessed it
value.description: Asha leans closer and asks whether Rosa was the witness.
evidence: Asha leaned in until her shoulder almost touched Lucia's
and asked, barely above breath, whether it had been Rosa

value.name: Lucia glances toward hallway
value.description: Lucia flicks her eyes toward the hallway, suggesting she is about to answer but remains cautious about being overheard.
evidence: Lucia's eyes flicked once past Asha's ear toward the hallwa
